mechanism: Perampanel induces CYP3A4, which may increase torsemide metabolism and reduce its diuretic efficacy; additionally, both drugs can affect electrolyte balance and potentially increase orthostatic hypotension risk.
action: Monitor diuretic response and serum electrolytes; assess for adequate fluid/electrolyte management and blood pressure control; consider alternative anticonvulsant if diuretic control becomes inadequate.
